newsitem.title: NEW ZEALAND: NZ First could work with Labour or National-Henare.
newsitem.headline: NZ First could work with Labour or National-Henare.

text.p: New Zealand First Deputy Leader Tau Henare said on Monday his party could work with either the National Party or the Labour Party.
Before the election Henare said NZ First would only coalesce with National if it dropped leader Jim Bolger, Finance Minister Bill Birch and Health Minister Jenny Shipley.
Henare told Radio New Zealand that his comments about the leaders three weeks ago were a "bungle" and a personal view.
"I'm ruled by the caucus just as much as anybody is," he said. "Just because I'm the deputy leader doesn't mean I always can have the final say in how we go."

Asked how easily NZ First could work with Bolger or Birch, he said: "It's going to be very, very, very difficult...I'm not kidding myself. I don't have any illusions about this. But at the end of the day things have to be done for the nation, not just for me."
